summary.text: TRESFJORDMAT AS is a private limited company registered in Tresfjord, founded 1998-06-29. TRESFJORDMAT AS is registered for retail trade in groceries and related assortment, and its statutory purpose is retail sale of groceries. Its main industry code is 47.110: non-specialised retail sale of predominately food, beverages or tobacco. The register shows 10 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 25 130 145 NOK and the annual result was 515 285 NOK; operating income was up from 22 564 784 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 355 363 NOK in 2024 to 515 285 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 6 227 943 NOK in 2024 to 6 743 229 NOK in 2025. The registered employee count went from 12 on 2025-11-13 to 10 on 2026-10-14. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
